detail.longDescription: Large language models (LLMs) as psychotherapists: an analysis based on psychodynamic psychotherapy theory | Ethics and Information Technology | Springer Nature Link https:// doi.org/10.1007/s10676-026-099 17-x From the conclusion: "… we have identified areas in which LLMs can support the psychotherapy process. Their subsidiary application should be the subject of increased interest among theorists and practitioners. The implementation of technology can significantly advance psychology and the capabilities of psychotherapists. This is particularly important given the shortage of psychological assistance in many areas. Moreover, it cannot be ruled out that technological developments will lead to further breakthroughs in our understanding of what consciousness and having a sense of “self” actually are. Although this turning point still seems distant, it already poses a multidimensional challenge for the psychological sciences, and encourages continuous analysis and re-evaluation of the capabilities of advanced AI systems." # psychotherapy # psychodynamic # LLMs # ChatGPT # companionship # therapy # AI
